verdict.rationale: Aider's scripting mode and Python API (docs-6, docs-7) let a user drive Aider programmatically across multiple files/tasks, and `/add` can bring many files into context at once (docs-1), enabling home-grown bulk workflows; a community user also mentions using Aider in a scripted, multi-step pipeline (aider-comm-15). However there is no first-party feature for batch/bulk operations (e.g. built-in loop over many items, glob-based multi-file edit command) — missing for 10: a documented bulk/batch command or example iterating over many files/items in one operation, and independent evidence of large-scale bulk runs succeeding.
